aicompanion_menu_owner_orders: Only its owner can give it orders (unless they let friends do so).
aicompanion_menu_busy: Someone has its things open. Try again in a moment.
aicompanion_menu_fallen_bed: Has fallen. Wakes in their bed in {0} s.
aicompanion_menu_fallen_you: Has fallen. Wakes beside you in {0} s.
aicompanion_menu_things_in_tomb: Their things are in their tombstone (the skull on your map).
aicompanion_menu_asking_host: Asking the host whether {0} is up somewhere: try again in a moment.
aicompanion_menu_on_the_way: {0} is on the way: they appear beside you in a moment.
aicompanion_menu_lost_bed: {0} is nowhere in the world: they fell and never woke up. Bring them back: they wake in their bed, with their skills, looks and settings.
aicompanion_menu_lost_you: {0} is nowhere in the world: they fell and never woke up. Bring them back: they wake beside you, with their skills, looks and settings.
aicompanion_menu_lost_tomb_at: Their things are in their tombstone, {0}: near it they put their gear back on.
aicompanion_menu_lost_tomb: Their things are in their tombstone where they fell.
aicompanion_menu_forget_hint: Or, if they are gone for good, forget them:
aicompanion_menu_last_seen: Out in the world, last seen {0} (far from you, so this game does not see them; the host's does).
aicompanion_menu_most_allowed: You have {0} companions, the most allowed (settings: MaxCompanions).
aicompanion_menu_summon_about: A viking who comes on adventures with you and, when you send them home, lives a life of their own at your base. They take a free bed and empty chests near them by themselves. You choose how they look next.
aicompanion_menu_summon_new_warn: This makes a new companion, starting from nothing. To see one you already have, go to where they are.
aicompanion_menu_same_name: You already have a companion called {0}. Give the new one another name, or go to {0}.
aicompanion_menu_hello: Hello! Give me a bed and a chest and I'll make my home here.
aicompanion_menu_brain_elsewhere: Its brain runs on the game of the player nearest to it; the details show there.
aicompanion_menu_not_fighting: Not fighting. It acts when an enemy comes within {0} m of it or you.
aicompanion_menu_shows_elsewhere: Shows on the game that runs it.
aicompanion_menu_hungry: Hungry: only {0} health and {1} stamina, and it does not heal. Give it food (Gear tab); it eats by itself.
aicompanion_menu_meals: {0}. It eats again when a food is half gone.
aicompanion_menu_rested: Rested for {0} more min: heals and gets its breath back faster.
aicompanion_menu_not_rested: Not rested. A while under a roof by a fire makes it rested.
aicompanion_menu_no_effects: None. Your boss power reaches it too when it is within 10 m of you.
aicompanion_menu_hold_key: Or hold {0} anywhere: all your companions near you come with you, or go home.
aicompanion_menu_before_food: Before food: {0} health and {1} stamina, as a player's. Food adds the rest.
aicompanion_menu_heals: Heals {0} health every 10 s from its food.
aicompanion_menu_heals_rested: Heals {0} health every 10 s from its food (rested: 50% more).
aicompanion_menu_heals_nothing: Heals nothing: it has not eaten (a player only heals from food).
aicompanion_menu_damage_hit: {0}: about {1} damage a hit (with its {2} skill)
aicompanion_menu_no_weapon: No weapon: it fights with its fists.
aicompanion_menu_blocks_shield: Blocks with its {0} just before a swing lands (a parry, once it has seen that creature swing), then hits back; steps aside from sweeps, shots and hits too hard to block.
aicompanion_menu_blocks_weapon: Blocks with its weapon when something swings at it (a shield blocks far better); steps aside from what it cannot block.
aicompanion_menu_blocks_nothing: Nothing to block with: it steps aside instead.
aicompanion_menu_careful_with: Careful with: {0} (they have killed it before: it uses its bow on them and keeps its distance).
aicompanion_menu_no_resistances: None: its gear gives no resistances (and no weaknesses).
aicompanion_menu_skills_about: As a player's: each rises as it uses it and makes it better at it. It loses 5% of every skill when it falls.
aicompanion_menu_skills_legend: Gold: its level out of 100. Green: on its way to the next level.
aicompanion_menu_order_gather: Lives its own life at home: works toward better gear (gathers what it needs, makes and upgrades it at your workbench and forge), stores what it finds in its chests, eats, cooks, repairs and defends the place.
aicompanion_menu_order_stay: Stays where it is and fights what comes near.
aicompanion_menu_order_guard: Stays by this spot, fights what comes near, and goes back to it after a fight.
aicompanion_menu_order_follow: Goes on adventures with you: follows you through portals and on boats, fights beside you, and picks up the loot. When its bag is full, its gear wears out or its food runs out, it tells you (and goes home by itself when home is near).
aicompanion_menu_errands_about: One click: it goes and does it now, then carries on with what it was doing (near its home). Or say it in chat: "{0}, restock", "gear up", "repair the base"...
aicompanion_menu_style_aggressive_about: Presses the attack and falls back only when badly hurt.
aicompanion_menu_style_defensive_about: Stays close to you, fights what comes near, and falls back early.
aicompanion_menu_style_passive_about: Never starts a fight; keeps by your side and keeps safe.
aicompanion_menu_style_balanced_about: Fights what threatens you or it, and falls back when hurt.
aicompanion_menu_style_auto_about: Reads what you are doing: fights beside you, helps you mine or chop, keeps close and only defends you while you travel, and where a place is too dangerous for its gear it tells you and only defends.
aicompanion_menu_runs_below_half: Below half of that it runs.
aicompanion_menu_fights_within_about: Of it or you (all your companions). Living at home it also fights anything that comes into its home.
aicompanion_menu_check_protect: Protects you first (goes for what attacks you)
aicompanion_menu_check_loot: Picks things up off the ground (what, in the Gear tab)
aicompanion_menu_check_autohome: Comes along when you head out, and lives at home again when you're back (with a bed)
aicompanion_menu_check_decisions: Shows what it decides in a fight above its head
aicompanion_menu_check_chatty: Tells you in chat what it is up to (what it makes, what it needs)
aicompanion_menu_talking_about: Start a chat message with its name: "{0}, follow me", "{0} go home", "{0}, be careful", "{0}, get your things", and the errands: "{0}, put away", "restock", "gear up", "repair your gear", "repair the base", "feed the fires", "cook". It answers above its head.
aicompanion_menu_send_away_about: Sends it away for good. Only with its bag empty, so nothing is lost.
aicompanion_menu_bed_is: Its bed is {0} m from you. It wakes there after falling and lives around it.
aicompanion_menu_no_bed: No bed yet: it wakes beside you after falling. Give it a bed nobody sleeps in.
aicompanion_menu_no_chests: No chests nearby. It stores what it finds in its chests and takes better gear, food, arrows and potions from them.
aicompanion_menu_take_chests: Take the empty chests beside its bed
aicompanion_menu_find_bed: Find it a free bed (and empty chests beside it)
aicompanion_menu_no_empty_chest: No empty chest within 8 m of its bed.
aicompanion_menu_no_free_bed: No free bed within 40 m of it (nobody sleeps in it, no companion has it).
aicompanion_menu_choosing_about: Choosing closes this menu: then E on a bed or a chest gives it to {0}, E again takes it back. {1} or Esc when done. Going home takes a free bed and empty chests near it by itself.
aicompanion_menu_your_chests_about: The chests at home that are not a companion's.
aicompanion_menu_check_stow: Puts what it gathers into your chests when its own are full (or it has none). It never takes anything out.
aicompanion_menu_check_pantry: Takes food from your chests to keep its food slots filled (food only, never anything else)
aicompanion_menu_check_armory: Takes better weapons, armour and tools from your chests and wears them (its old ones go back in the chest)
aicompanion_menu_pantry_on: On: when its food slots run low it takes food from your chests at home (and says what it took). Materials for its gear it only ever takes from its own chests.
aicompanion_menu_pantry_off: Off: it eats from its own chests, forages, hunts and cooks, and asks you in chat when it runs out. It never takes anything from your chests.
aicompanion_menu_no_mission: No mission right now: nothing better to make or upgrade at the stations near its home. Build a workbench (and a forge) near its home, or give it better tools.
aicompanion_menu_mission_at_home: It sets itself a mission when it goes home.
aicompanion_menu_mission_since: Mission since day {0}: {1}% of the way
aicompanion_menu_smelt_one: {0} needs smelting: it puts the ore in its chest for you (or FeedFromChests) to smelt.
aicompanion_menu_smelt_many: {0} need smelting: it puts the ore in its chest for you (or FeedFromChests) to smelt.
aicompanion_menu_needs_from_you: Needs from you: {0}. Put it in its chest.
aicompanion_menu_missions_about: It sets its own missions (its next piece of better gear) and sticks to them; it decides for itself when to give one up, and says why.
aicompanion_menu_not_living: It is not living at home now.
aicompanion_menu_home_set: Its home is the area you set, {0} m from you: it stores its things, works, sorts into your chests and comes home there. Its bed is where it sleeps.
aicompanion_menu_home_bed: Its home is around its bed. Set it to your base instead if its bed is off to one side.
aicompanion_menu_home_none: With no bed it lives around where it was told to ({0}, {1}).
aicompanion_menu_make_home: Make this its home (where I stand)
aicompanion_menu_duties_about: What it does at home, top to bottom. It works the first duty that is on until its stockpile holds the amount you set (or your plans are built), then the next one. When all are done it goes back to living its own life.
aicompanion_menu_put_its_own: Put it in its own chest
aicompanion_menu_duties_no_chest: No chest of yours near its home that it can use: duties wait for one.
aicompanion_menu_duties_stow_off: Putting things in your chests is off (Your chests, below): duties wait until you switch it on.
aicompanion_menu_duties_no_own_chest: It has no chest of its own: duties wait. Give it one in Bed and chests above.
aicompanion_menu_duties_counts: What is in your chests at home counts: with 300 wood there and 100 asked for, it rests.
aicompanion_menu_install_buildorders: Install BuildOrders, then plan pieces at your base (hammer out, Left Alt): it builds them, paying from its bag and your chests.
aicompanion_menu_needs_axe: It needs an axe (put one in its chest).
aicompanion_menu_needs_pickaxe: It needs a pickaxe (put one in its chest).
aicompanion_menu_needs_weapon: It needs a weapon to hunt; it can still forage.
aicompanion_menu_duties_cook: A cooking station near home lets it cook what it hunts. Hungry, it feeds itself first whatever the duty.
aicompanion_menu_check_frugal: Eats only what it needs when it is calm at home (the cheapest food that will do)
aicompanion_menu_frugal_on: Out with you, in a fight or hurt it eats its three best meals as a player does. Calm at home it keeps one or two meals going (none while asleep and well), and uses berries, mushrooms and the like before your good meat.
aicompanion_menu_frugal_off: Off: it keeps three meals going all the time, the best first. That is a lot of food.
aicompanion_menu_today_took: Today: ate {0} meals, took {1} of your food (up to {2} a day).
aicompanion_menu_most_a_day: Most it takes from yours a day
aicompanion_menu_other_jobs: Other jobs (not used while a duty is on)
aicompanion_menu_jobs_auto: Nothing switched on: it decides for itself, gathering what its goal needs and what its tools allow. Right now: {0}.
aicompanion_menu_jobs_auto_nothing: Nothing switched on: it decides for itself, gathering what its goal needs and what its tools allow. Right now: nothing (no tools, and enough food).
aicompanion_menu_jobs_chosen: It does only what is switched on (still preferring what its goal needs). Switch everything off to let it decide for itself.
aicompanion_menu_job_ore: Ore: copper, tin, iron, silver deposits
aicompanion_menu_job_forage: Forage: wild berries, mushrooms, flowers (never your crops)
aicompanion_menu_job_hunt: Hunt: deer, boar, necks and hares
aicompanion_menu_job_cook: Cook its raw food on a cooking station
aicompanion_menu_job_loot: Pick up everything on the ground (also what players drop)
aicompanion_menu_tools_about: A better axe or pickaxe works harder trees and ores (the game's tool tiers). At its workbench it also upgrades and makes gear when it has the materials.
aicompanion_menu_away_off: When you come back it catches up on the work it would have done: trees felled, rocks mined, berries picked, into its chests.
aicompanion_menu_away_real: When you come back it catches up on its work, and on fights with the creatures around its home, which can go badly: it can fall (its things in a tombstone nearby, which it goes back for).
aicompanion_menu_away_mild: When you come back it catches up on the work it would have done (trees felled, rocks mined, berries picked, into its chests), and fights off a few creatures, keeping what they drop. It never falls while you are away.
aicompanion_menu_if_falls_about: As a player: its things go into its tombstone (a skull on everyone's map), it wakes {0} s later in its bed (or beside you), and goes back for its things. E on its tombstone gives them back to it.
aicompanion_menu_gear_take_back: Click a piece of gear to take it back. It moves the best it has into these slots by itself.
aicompanion_menu_gear_point: Point at a piece to see what it is.
aicompanion_menu_its_bag: Its bag  ({0} of {1} slots, weight {2} of {3})
aicompanion_menu_too_heavy: Too heavy: it cannot run until it puts something down.
aicompanion_menu_bag_about: What it carries goes into its tombstone when it falls. To give or take from its bag, open your inventory (Tab) next to it: its bag shows beside yours.
aicompanion_menu_give_gear: Give it gear from your inventory
aicompanion_menu_give_gear_none: Weapons, shields, bows, arrows, axes, pickaxes, hammers and armour you are not wearing show here.
aicompanion_menu_click_to_give: Click to give: it goes into its gear slot (what was there goes into its bag).
aicompanion_menu_picks_up_about: As it walks by, and fresh drops near it (what you mine and chop, what creatures drop). Never what a player dropped.
aicompanion_menu_loot_off: Picking up is switched off (Orders tab).
aicompanion_menu_owner_gear: Only its owner can change its gear.
aicompanion_menu_owner_looks: Only its owner can change how it looks.
aicompanion_menu_how_it_looks_about: As when you make a character. Everyone sees the same, and it wakes looking the same after it falls. It changes as you click: turn round to watch.
aicompanion_menu_no_moments: Nothing written yet: its first kills, parries, trips and the gear it makes will show here.

aicompanion_duties_getting_many: Getting {0} for your plan ({1} pieces left)

aicompanion_duties_making: Making materials for your plan ({0} left)

aicompanion_duties_building_many: Building: {0} pieces left in your plans
aicompanion_duties_nothing_near: Nothing to find near home just now: {0} of {1}

aicompanion_chores_put_back_food: put back {0} food it borrowed from your chest
aicompanion_chores_thanks_potion: Thanks, I'll keep that for a bad moment.
aicompanion_chores_only_food: Only food and potions can be given this way. To give {0} gear, open your inventory next to it (Tab).

aicompanion_errands_too_far: It is too far from home for that.
aicompanion_errands_food_for_road: I'll grab some food for the road.

aicompanion_errands_nothing_to_fix: Nothing in the base needs fixing.
aicompanion_errands_need_hammer: I need a hammer for that.

aicompanion_errands_fires_fed: The fires are all well fed.
aicompanion_errands_no_stove: There's no cooking station by a fire I can use.

aicompanion_armory_found: Found better gear in your chest: {0}.
